en: The image shows a black and white view of a historic hilltop complex with fortified stone walls and several large buildings featuring traditional European architecture and steep roofs. A prominent church spire rises above the complex. In the foreground, there are manicured gardens, a fountain, and a statue, suggesting a picturesque and significant landmark. The text at the top right reads 'Tallinn-Eesti. - 21₰. - Toompea'.
